issues.what: ledger/58 gives Russia a 300 km disc round the Kolyma in 1643 (3,428 cells: Magadan 1,383, Sakha 578, Chukotka 435 and more) and the 1645 keyframe then removes 3,252 cells. The page: Stadukhin 'reaches Kolyma' in 1643, control is 'a network of winter outposts and forts', boundaries 'very vaguely defined', Chukotka annexed 1778. Disc cut to the Kolyma land of Cliopatria's 1645 Russian shape; the 1645 snap falls from 3,252 to 511 cells removed.

li-zicheng_1644 (Cliopatria 1642 shape plus Beijing) holds only 517 of Shaanxi's 965 cells, so 419 Shaanxi cells go to nobody for 1644 and return in 1645. The page: Li fled to Xi'an after Beijing, Dorgon sent armies in October 'to expel Li Zicheng from his stronghold in Shaanxi', he left Xi'an in February 1645. Shaanxi added to the 1644 shape; the 1644 snap (420 removed) disappears and the 1645 snap of li-zicheng_1645 falls from 419 cells added to 0.

Xi dynasty's keyframes (whole Sichuan) take 438 Kham cells (Garze and Aba, 97.5-101.8 E, 28.8-33.9 N) from Tibet, the Khoshut vassal, in 1644; with a ruling for 1644 alone they pass to Xi in 1645 and to nobody in 1646-47. Ruling for Tibet 1644-1646; the cells stay Tibet's (vassal of Khoshut) through 1649. The Khoshut page: Güshi crushed the king of Beri in winter 1640-41 and held 'Ü-Tsang and Kham'; it never mentions Xi or Sichuan.

republic-of-venice ledger/122 and keyframes 1647 and 1648 name 'Souda', which the gazetteer lacks, so they were skipped and Venice kept 11 rural Cretan cells to 1649. Re-issued with Souda by coordinates (24.15 E, 35.5 N, one cell). The Cretan War page: 'By the beginning of 1648, all of Crete, except Candia and a few strongholds like the island of Gramvousa, was in Ottoman hands'; Souda is named only in the 1669 terms.

Residual of the Crete fix: the Ottoman keyframe ottoman-empire_1648 (verdict ok, Cliopatria's shape) does not include the rural Cretan cells, so its snap removes 12 of them to nobody in 1648-1649 (before: Venice held them). Overriding that keyframe would reach 1661, so it is left for the orchestrator.

kutai-kingdom owns no land at all from 1635 (and in the 1640 anchor): its keyframes and ledger/1 name 'Muara Kaman' and the 1300-1634 keyframe names 'Kutai Lama', neither in the gazetteer. Event 1640 gain (Cliopatria 1648 outline plus a 30 km disc round Muara Kaman at 116.72 E, 0.2 S, the coordinates of the kutai-martadipura dossier) and the 1648 keyframe by coordinates: 38 cells 1640-1649. Page: Aji Pangeran Sinum Panji Mendapa (ruled 1635-1650) 'merged the two realms'; capital 'believed to be the current Muara Kaman district'; sultanate to 1844.

mughal-empire_1648 drops 78 Kandahar cells to nobody a year early (dossier note: 'Cliopatria starts it a year early'). The page: Mughal control from 1638, siege began 28 December 1648, captured 22 February 1649. Kandahar cells of the 1640 shape added to the 1648 shape; the Safavid gain of 1649 now moves 152 cells instead of 74 and the 1648 snap removes 66 instead of 144.

1,990 cells of the Ming's end (ming-dynasty/ledger/73) fall to nobody in 1644: Gansu 967, Ningxia 205 (Ningxia then taken by the Qing 1645 keyframe, Gansu by the Qing only in 1646), Henan 301, Jiangsu 194, Anhui 128, Hubei 62; north Jiangsu stays nobody's (about 204 cells) to 1649. The Southern Ming page says only that the remnant Ming 'could only survive south of the Huai River' and names no taker; nothing dates who held these cells.

khoshut-khanate/xi-dynasty (1,981 cell-years) and khoshut-khanate/southern-ming (434, Yunnan 81, Sichuan 61): Khoshut wins both. After the Kham ruling the Xi conflict falls to 1,105 cell-years, all in the Khoshut keyframe of 1645 (Garze/Aba plateau edge); the Khoshut page does not mention Yunnan, Lijiang or Sichuan, so the Yunnan cells cannot be confirmed or refuted.

Dutch Brazil: dutch-brazil/colonial-brazil conflict (213 Paraiba and Rio Grande do Norte cells, 1641) won by the Dutch, and the Dutch leave Sao Luis in 1645 as the ledger has it. The page: 'by 1641, the Dutch captured Sao Luis'; 'Still in that year [1645], the Dutch abandoned Sao Luis'; 'In 1645, most of Dutch Brazil revolted'.

Kazakh-Dzungar contest (kazakh-khanate/oirat-confederation, 1,272 cells, since 1643, open at the end) is a long war that the dossier closes in 1658; drawn as a striped Semirechye zone in the Dzungar colour. Counterpart slug oirat-confederation ended in 1634 (dzungar-khanate follows), the picture is right.

Other flagged items not examined for want of pages: cossack-hetmanate over tsardom-of-russia (89 cells, Sumy 61, 1649), bijapur/golconda (258 cell-years), kengtung over southern-ming (Shan 98, Yunnan 15: the small Shan state rightly wins), jesuit-reducciones_1640 snap (786 Guairá/Itatin cells removed in 1640 with no ledger event, presumably an earlier event of the previous window: page not opened), saadi-sultanate_1641 snap (578 cells), southern-ming keeping Anhui (453-465 cells) and a 183-cell south-Henan exclave in 1648-1649 from Cliopatria's 1648 shape, the Qing's Jiangxi/Hubei/Hunan dated 1649. The one-cell dutch-gold-coast ledger/8 ('Egya') stays unresolved.
